beers.name: Sunbreak Pils
beers.description: A crisp, bright German-style pilsner brewed with Hallertau Mittelfrüh hops. Snappy bitterness, clean lager finish. Perfect for a sunny afternoon at the festival.

beers.name: Slipstream IPA
beers.description: Our flagship Northwest IPA. Citra, Mosaic, and Simcoe build a juicy citrus core over a clean malt backbone.

beers.name: Mountain Fog
beers.description: Soft and pillowy. Galaxy, Nelson Sauvin, and a touch of oats. Tropical fruit forward — passionfruit, mango, white grape.

beers.name: Boardwalk Pale
beers.description: Session-friendly Seattle pale. Bright, hop-forward, refreshingly drinkable.

beers.name: Foghorn Stout
beers.description: Robust, roasty, with notes of dark chocolate, coffee, and a whisper of vanilla. Smooth, dry finish.

beers.name: Saltwater Saison
beers.description: Brewed with sea salt and coriander. Funky, peppery, slightly briny. A summer farmhouse ale.

beers.name: Tide Pool Gose
beers.description: Light, tart, salty, with hints of lemon zest. Quenching on a hot day.

beers.name: Trailhead IPA
beers.description: Yakima Valley hops, full stop. Piney, resinous, and just bitter enough to make you reach for the next sip.

beers.name: Old Growth Porter
beers.description: Cocoa, espresso, and a touch of caramel. Roasty without being heavy.

beers.name: Driftwood Brown
beers.description: Toasty, nutty, with a kiss of brown sugar. The kind of beer you bring to a campfire.

beers.name: Ferry Lane Lager
beers.description: An unpretentious helles-style lager. Bready malt, soft floral hop, clean finish.

beers.name: Highline Hefeweizen
beers.description: Banana, clove, and a fluffy wheat body. Unfiltered and proud of it.

beers.name: Compass Rose Tripel
beers.description: Golden, effervescent, dangerously drinkable. Spicy yeast, pear, and a long dry finish.

beers.name: North Beach Wit
beers.description: Coriander, orange peel, soft wheat. Light and aromatic — a porch beer.

beers.name: Heron's Reach Pale
beers.description: A clean, accessible American pale ale. Cascade hops, biscuit malt, no surprises — just well-made beer.

beers.name: Tugboat Triple IPA
beers.description: Three hops, ten alcohol, zero apologies. Big citrus, big resin, big finish. Sip slowly.

beers.name: Mariner's Helles
beers.description: A traditional Bavarian-style helles. Soft, slightly sweet, very drinkable.

beers.name: Salish Stout
beers.description: Smooth and silky from a generous oat addition. Chocolate, coffee, and a hint of toasted bread.

beers.name: Olympic Amber
beers.description: Toffee and caramel malts balanced by a clean hop bitterness. The amber you remember.

beers.name: Cascade Foeder Wild Ale
beers.description: Aged 18 months in oak foeders. Funky, tart, with notes of green apple and pinot grapes. A standout for sour drinkers.

beers.name: Rainshadow Cider
beers.description: Dry, crisp, made from Pacific Northwest heirloom apples. Subtle tannins, bright acidity.

beers.name: Orchard Lane Cider
beers.description: Off-dry and approachable. Honeycrisp and Gravenstein blend.

beers.name: Smoked Cherry Cider
beers.description: Cherry juice with a kiss of smoked malt. Unusual, slightly polarizing, worth seeking out.

beers.name: Old Knight Barleywine
beers.description: Aged in bourbon barrels for 12 months. Vanilla, oak, dried fruit, a long warming finish. Pour small, drink slow.

beers.name: Heather Scotch Ale
beers.description: A small-batch wee heavy brewed with heather tips. Layered caramel and a soft floral note.

beers.name: Imperial Coconut Porter
beers.description: Toasted coconut, dark chocolate, and a touch of vanilla. Dessert in a glass.

beers.name: Last-Minute Lager
beers.description: Brewery and recipe announced day-of. Watch the board near the entrance for details.

beers.name: Hopback IPA
beers.description: Old-school West Coast IPA with assertive bittering hops. ABV in source data includes the percent sign — the importer should treat this as missing rather than choking.

beers.name: Garden Variety Saison
beers.description: Source data publishes an ABV range instead of a single number. App should fall back to no ABV.

beers.name: Smoke Signal Rauchbier
beers.description: Beechwood-smoked malts. Bacon-forward. ABV was a placeholder string in the published list.
